description: This file defines an abstract class 'MonkeyMotionEvent' which models motion events (like touch or gesture events) for the Android 'monkey' testing tool. It manages properties like pointers, timing, device ID, and event action, and provides methods to build and inject motion events into the system.

classes.name: MonkeyMotionEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing motion events in the Android monkey testing framework, capable of constructing and injecting motion input events.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds a pointer with specified id, position (x, y), pressure, and size to the motion event.

methods.name: setIntermediateNote
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating whether this is an intermediate step for verbose logging.

methods.name: getIntermediateNote
methods.description: Returns whether this event is marked as an intermediate note.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action type of the motion event (e.g., ACTION_DOWN, ACTION_MOVE).

methods.name: getDownTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the gesture or touch started.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the current event.

methods.name: setDownTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the gesture or touch started.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the current event.

methods.name: setMetaState
methods.description: Sets the meta state (e.g., modifier keys) for the event.

methods.name: setPrecision
methods.description: Sets the X and Y precision for the event.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.description: Sets the device ID that generated this event.

methods.name: setEdgeFlags
methods.description: Sets edge flags for the event.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Constructs the MotionEvent and injects it into the system using InputManager; returns success or failure code.
